Switzerland with Kids: 10-Day Family-Friendly Itinerary

An easy-paced 10-day family route through Zurich, Lucerne, and Interlaken, Grindelwald & Jungfrau Region with interactive museums, parks, and minimal hotel changes.

Last reviewed: October 23, 2026 · Prices are approximate and for orientation only.

On this page

  1. Route at a glance
  2. Day-by-day plan
  3. Transport &amp; rail pass notes
  4. What to book ahead
  5. Ways to adapt this route

Route at a glance

Designed around just two main hotel bases (Zurich and Lucerne) so families spend less time packing and more time enjoying Switzerland.

Length10 days
Best forFamilies with children
BasesZurich (5 nights), Lucerne (5 nights)
PaceRelaxed, stroller-friendly

Transport & rail pass notes

Children often travel free or at deep discounts on SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways and city metro networks.

What to book ahead

  • Family rooms with extra beds
  • Reserved table seats on trains

Ways to adapt this route

  • Keep afternoons flexible for playgrounds, gelato/snack stops, and rest.

Destination guides on this route

Zurich

Riverside Old Town guild houses, Lake Zurich swim clubs, world-class art museums and alpine day-trip rail hub.

Lucerne

Timber Chapel Bridge, frescoed Old Town squares, Lake Lucerne paddle steamers and Mount Pilatus & Rigi.

Interlaken, Grindelwald & Jungfrau Region

Eiger, Mönch and Jungfrau peaks, Lauterbrunnen's 72 waterfalls, Wengen, Mürren and Lake Thun & Brienz.
